in_sanskrit.name: श्रीजेश
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: A combination of Shree (Goddess of Wealth, Prosperity, or Lakshmi) and Jesh (Victory, Conquer, or Rule).

in_hindi.name: श्रीजेश
in_hindi.long_meaning: A combination of श्री (Shree) which means Goddess of Wealth, Prosperity, or Lakshmi and जेश (Jesh) which means Victory, Conquer, or Rule.

in_tamil.name: ஶ்ரீஜேஷ்
in_tamil.long_meaning: A combination of ஶ்ரீ (Shree) which means Goddess of Wealth, Prosperity, or Lakshmi and ஜேஷ் (Jesh) which means Victory, Conquer, or Rule.

in_telugu.name: శ్రీజేష్

in_marathi.name: Shreejesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shreejesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Shree means prosperity and Jesh means god. Thus, Shreejesh means God of Prosperity.

in_bengali.long_meaning: Shreejesh একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Shree means prosperity and Jesh means god. Thus, Shreejesh means God of Prosperity.
